topic: Missing the deferred interest deadline on a no interest furniture deal vs paying it off early (Douglas vs Catalina)

scenes.narration: No interest for two years can mean all the interest at once. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench beside a sofa with a tag reading NO INTEREST TWENTY FOUR MONTHS and tiny red fine print, comic burst banner reads ALL AT ONCE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Douglas and Catalina both buy a three thousand dollar sofa on store financing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man douglas and woman catalina each sitting on a new gray sofa with a tag reading THREE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The deal says no interest if paid in full within twenty four months.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a financing sign reading NO INTEREST IF PAID IN FULL IN TWENTY FOUR MONTHS, a magnifying glass on IF, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Douglas pays the minimum, one hundred dollars a month, and relaxes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man douglas lounging on the sofa paying one hundred dollars on a phone app, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Month twenty four ends with six hundred dollars still owed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a statement reading BALANCE SIX HUNDRED, a calendar reads MONTH TWENTY FOUR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The bank charges interest on the full three thousand from day one.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a statement line reading DEFERRED INTEREST CHARGED ONE THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED, man douglas falling off the sofa, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His three thousand dollar sofa now costs four thousand four hundred.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, the sofa with a new price tag reading FOUR THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Catalina divides three thousand by twenty two and sets autopay for one forty.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman catalina writing a calculation reading THREE THOUSAND DIVIDED BY TWENTY TWO, an autopay screen reads ONE FORTY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She pays it off two months before the deadline.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman catalina celebrating beside a statement reading PAID IN FULL, a calendar reads MONTH TWENTY TWO, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Interest charged, zero. Sofa cost, exactly three thousand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a receipt reading INTEREST ZERO, TOTAL THREE THOUSAND, sparkles, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Douglas paid fourteen hundred extra. Catalina paid the sticker price.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man douglas beside a bill reading FOURTEEN HUNDRED INTEREST, woman catalina beside a bill reading ZERO, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Deferred interest is a trap. Pay it off before the deadline. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel beside a calendar with the deadline circled and a stamp reading PAID EARLY, kids comic book illustration
